The organization is a design, development, and support agency specializing in Drupal and WordPress platforms. It serves mission-driven clients by creating and maintaining websites that support their objectives. The company emphasizes the importance of its team members' growth, well-being, and success, recognizing that these elements contribute directly to client outcomes.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are?

Cleantech Industry Resources accelerates United States solar, battery storage and EV projects by providing turnkey development as a service including 100% internal systems engineering. The company deploys a leading team that spun out of the largest solar power producer in the world. This team operates within a sophisticated suite of software to support projects from land origination, through to commercial operation.

Location of Position:

Chennai, India (Remote Coordination for USA-based Projects)

What We Offer

Opportunity to join a top-notch, collaborative team of professionals
Fantastic team environment and collaborative culture
Professional development opportunities to grow into an industry leader
Medical Insurance for the employee and family
Spot Recognition bonus for exceptional performance
Long Term Incentive policy
Regular team outings, events, and activities to foster a positive work environment

Our Commitment to Diversity

At CIR, we are dedicated to nurturing a diverse and equitable workforce that truly reflects our community. We deeply value each person’s unique perspective, skills, and experiences. CIR embraces all individuals, regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, or nationality. We are steadfast in our commitment to fostering a just and inclusive world through intentional policies and actions. Your individuality enriches our collective strength, and we strive to ensure everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered.

Position Summary

The Project Manager will oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of solar projects executed in the United States while coordinating remotely from India. This role involves managing cross-functional teams, ensuring project milestones are met, and maintaining seamless communication with internal teams, external stakeholders, and clients. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in project planning and control within the solar industry and possess strong leadership, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

Core Responsibilities

Project Planning and Execution

Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables based on contractual agreements.
Develop detailed project plans, schedules, and budgets using tools like MS Projects, Primavera, and Procore, ensuring alignment with organizational goals.
Conduct critical path analysis and adjust project schedules using project management software to meet deadlines and milestones.
Coordinate procurement of materials and equipment with supply chain teams, ensuring timely delivery.
Stakeholder Coordination and Communication

Act as the primary point of contact for internal teams, suppliers, contractors, and clients in the USA.
Facilitate effective communication and alignment across time zones, ensuring stakeholder satisfaction.
Use CRM tools to maintain comprehensive records of stakeholder communications and project updates.
Provide regular project updates and status reports through Procore or similar platforms to internal and external stakeholders.
Team Leadership and Coordination

Collaborate with engineering, development, SCM, and business development teams to ensure smooth project execution.
Assign tasks and responsibilities to team members while tracking progress using MS Projects and Procore.
Utilize internal CRM tools for task management, tracking deliverables, and facilitating team collaboration.
Foster a collaborative team environment, encouraging innovation and efficiency.
Risk Management and Compliance

Identify project risks, assess their impact, and develop mitigation strategies, documenting them within Procore or Primavera.
Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and environmental standards during project execution.
Monitor regulatory requirements and collaborate with stakeholders to secure necessary permits.
Budget and Financial Management

Develop and manage project budgets, tracking expenses and ensuring cost control using CRM and financial tools.
Monitor project financials, including invoicing, revenue tracking, and overhead management.
Identify cost-saving opportunities and implement efficiency improvements, leveraging insights from Procore and CRM analytics.
Documentation and Reporting

Maintain accurate project documentation, including contracts, schedules, and progress reports, using MS Projects, Procore, and CRM systems.
Prepare and circulate daily, weekly, and monthly progress reports, ensuring alignment with organizational standards.
Archive project records within Procore or CRM platforms for compliance and future reference.
Commissioning and Post-Project Evaluation

Oversee the commissioning process, ensuring solar projects are fully operational and documented within project management tools.
Coordinate the handover of completed projects to clients or operations teams using Procore for streamlined documentation.
Conduct post-project evaluations to identify lessons learned and best practices for future projects, leveraging reports from CRM and Procore.

Education Requirements

Bachelors/master’s degree in electrical/mechanical engineering.

Technical Skills and Experience

Experience

8+ years of experience in project management within the solar or renewable energy sector.
Proven experience in managing large-scale solar projects (100MW+ preferred).
Familiarity with US-based regulatory and compliance standards for renewable energy projects is an advantage.
Technical Skills

Proficiency in project management tools: Primavera P6, MS Project, SAP, and AutoCAD.
Advanced skills in CRM tools and Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel for reporting.
Basic knowledge of PVsyst and other solar-specific design software is a plus.
Soft Skills

Strong problem-solving, analytical, and critical-thinking abilities.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with an ability to manage cross-cultural teams.
Robust multitasking and time management skills to coordinate across time zones effectively.

Psychosocial Skills /Human Skills/Behavioural Skills

Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
Project Management experience a plus.
Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to take ideas and run with them from concept to conclusion.
Technical understanding of clean energy business processes
Exceptional verbal and writing communication skills with superiors, peers, partners, and other stakeholders.
Excellent interpersonal skills while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment.

Additional Requirements

Ability to work flexible hours to accommodate US time zones.
Strong understanding of solar energy systems, construction processes, and commissioning requirements.
Commitment to driving projects with professionalism, integrity, and a focus on quality.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. The physical demands of this job require an individual to be able to work at a computer for most of the day, be able to participate in conference calls and travel to team retreats on a time-to-time basis. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Work Conditions

The work environment is usually quiet (normal city traffic noises are common), a blend of artificial and natural light, temperate and generally supports a collaborative work environment. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Cleantech Industry Resources, we embrace diversity and uphold a strong dedication to establishing an all-encompassing atmosphere for both our staff and associates. Our choices in employment are free from any bias related to race, creed, nationality, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, physical limitations, veteran status, or any other legally safeguarded attributes.
Being an integral part of Cleantech Industry Resources means you can expect to be immersed in a realm of professional possibilities within a culture that nurtures teamwork, adaptability, and the embracing of all.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
採用企業:
SHHH Limited
勤務地:
日本国内でのリモート勤務（主に東京都内での対面ミーティングあり）
雇用形態:
業務委託（有期契約）
契約期間:
18か月（更新の可能性あり）
募集人数:
1名
レポート先:
経営陣および香港本社

会社について

SHHH Groupは、「Hair Is Where Vitality Becomes Visible.（髪は、生命力が目に見える場所）」という信念のもとに生まれた、香港発のヘア＆ウェルネスブランドです。東洋のウェルネスの知恵、現代的な処方設計、静かで個性あるデザインを融合しています。

日本は、私たちの国際展開の次の成長段階における中核市場です。このポジションでは、既存の成功パターンを踏襲するだけでなく、グローバルブランドが日本で共感と信頼を獲得し、長く根づくための方法を自ら形にしていただきます。

ポジション概要

日本市場におけるプロジェクトを立ち上げから完了まで統括し、所定の品質、予算および期限に従って成果を届けるポジションです。

計画、実行、進捗管理、完了報告に加え、リソース管理、関係者との調整およびリスク対応を担っていただきます。

主な業務内容

プロジェクトの目的、範囲、成果物、スケジュール、予算および実行計画の策定
優先順位とリソースを管理し、初期計画から完了までプロジェクトをリード
社内外の関係者を調整し、会議を運営して合意したアクションの実行を管理
遅延、リスクおよび運営上の問題を早期に発見し、現実的な解決策を実行
品質、予算および成果を確認し、明確な進捗報告と完了報告を作成

必須要件

プロ ジェクトマネジメントまたは関連業務で5年以上（目安： 5〜10年）の実務経験
複数の社内外関係者が関わるプロジェクトをリード・管理した実績
スケジュール、予算、リソース、リスクおよび外部業者を管理した経験
高い組織力、問題解決力および意思決定力
リモート環境で自律的に業務を進め、必要に応じて日本国内（主に都内）で対面ミーティングに参加できること

歓迎要件

ビューティー、ウェルネス、ラグジュアリー、小売、EC、クリエイティブまたは広告業界での経験
日本市場への参入、ブランド開発または事業拡大プロジェクトの経験
グローバル企業または多国籍チームでの業務経験
PMPまたはその他のプロジェクトマネジメント資格

求める人物像

計画を具体的な行動に落とし込み、最終成果まで責任を持てる方
グローバル企業、または日本と海外市場をつなぐプロジェクトでの業務経験がある方
オープンマインドで文化的な柔軟性があり、外資系企業のスピード感や働き方に適応できる方
自ら行動し、率直に意見を交わしながら、世界水準の成果を届けることに集中できる方
英語または中国語でのコミュニケーション力があると尚可。必要に応じて業務用の翻訳ツールを活用し、正確に業務を進められる方

雇用条件

契約期間:
18か月の有期契約
勤務場所:
フルリモートワーク（日本国内）。※必要に応じて指定場所（主に東京都内）での対面ミーティングあり
勤務時間:
定めなし（プロジェクトの進捗・納期および合意した成果物の品質を軸とした柔軟な稼働形態）
給与:
応相談。経験・能力・想定稼働量を考慮の上、当社規定により決定
業務範囲:
上記業務およびプロジェクトマネジメントに直接関連する業務全般

応募方法

履歴書および職務経歴書を hello@shhh.group へご提出くださ い。その際、これまでに担当した主なプロジェクト、担当範囲および成果を簡潔にご記載ください。書類選考を通過した方にのみ面接のご案内を差し上げます。
※応募時点で、日本国内で合法的に就労できる在留資格・権利をお持ちの方に限ります。

About the Team:

The App Assure team is an integral part of the Security Engineering division. We work closely with customers and technology partners from around the world to drive product integration, address app compatibility issues, and shape the future of Security. As a team member, you will be responsible for understanding complex real-world scenarios, gathering feedback from customers and technology partners, providing valuable insights to the product development cycle, and helping technology partners to integrate products with Security solutions. Joining our exciting and diverse group will allow you to help technology partners align their solutions with the Security team, enabling customers to detect and mitigate risks faster. Our technology partners play a critical role in driving the usage of our services and building solutions ranging from enterprise applications and services to niche departmental business process apps. As such, it is extremely important to ensure that partners have the technical skills necessary to build and sustain a vibrant security business. Evangelizing our partners' needs throughout our engineering organization as part of the engineering lifecycle is critical to our long sustainability. We partner with them to fix application compatibility issues with the latest versions of Microsoft products, such as Windows, Windows on Arm, M365 Apps, Edge, Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Windows 365 Cloud PC, and Surface, M365 Copilot. Cloud technologies are constantly evolving, and we are seeking active learners who can collaborate with a global team of stakeholders. The ability to navigate ambiguity and thrive in a fast-paced environment is essential to success in this role.

About the Role:

The role involves managing technical relationships between the Security team and key strategic ISVs (independent software vendors), driving co-engineering initiatives, and partnering with CSS and product teams to remove technical roadblocks.

Responsibilities:

Manage technical relationships between the Security team and key strategic ISVs (independent software vendors).
Drive any co-engineering initiatives between Security and ISVs.
Partnering with CSS and product teams to remove technical roadblocks and discuss product roadmaps with the ISVs’ engineering teams; channel relevant product feedback to the feature teams to help with prioritization.
Help customers and ISVs (independent software vendors) as well as strategic partners fix application compatibility issues with the latest versions of our Microsoft products, such as Windows, Windows on Arm, M365 Apps, Edge, Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Windows 365 Cloud PC, and Surface, M365 Copilot.
Represent the App Assure team in engineering initiatives and feature previews to drive key business outcomes and bring feedback from the breadth of our audiences.
Track and improve Partner satisfaction with our platform, and regular report outs on impact and opportunities.

Qualifications:

Ability to ramp to L100+ on Microsoft Security technology.
Knowledge on Microsoft products, such as Windows, Windows on Arm, M365 Apps, Edge, Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Windows 365 Cloud PC, and Surface, M365 Copilot.
Direct experience working with Partners is highly desired.
Solid collaboration, communication, and cross-teaming skills.
Comfortable working autonomously in a fast-paced environment where new challenges exist around every corner.
Prioritization, time management and organizational skills.
Ability to take on complex systems and processes and drive simplification and improvements.
Self-starter, who can deal with ambiguity, maintains focus, drives clarity, and provides innovative solutions.
Minimum three years of work experience in the computer software industry; with a focus in security, cloud, and/or security solutions is preferred.
French Speaking Proficiency at advanced level.

Preferred Skills:

Desire and eagerness to help customers successfully deploy our technologies.
Strong collaboration, communication, prioritization, and organizational skills.
Ability to take on and streamline complex orchestrations and deal with ambiguity.
Comfortable working autonomously in a fast-paced environment where new challenges exist around every corner.
Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science or related discipline, or equivalent experience.

jobs.description:
The University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center is seeking a Facilities Project Manager to provide project management expertise for capital facility projects. The Facilities Project Manager supports facilities planning, design, and construction activities through effective coordination of project scope, schedules, budgets, stakeholders, documentation, and regulatory compliance. The Facilities Project Manager plays a key role in ensuring projects are completed according to institutional standards and project objectives.

UT MD Anderson is a leading institution focused on cancer care, research, education, and prevention. The Facilities Project Manager contributes to the development and maintenance of facilities and infrastructure that support the organization's mission while ensuring quality, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance.

The ideal candidate is a seasoned Project Manager with 10+ years of experience leading complex construction projects in healthcare, education, or commercial environments. They bring strong construction management expertise, including experience as an Owner's Representative, and are skilled in managing budgets, schedules, contractors, design consultants, RFIs, submittals, and change orders.

Success in this role requires excellent stakeholder management, strong communication skills, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. The ideal candidate is passionate about delivering innovative projects that enhance the end-user experience and support a meaningful mission.

Salary Range: $106,500 - $133,000 - $159,500

Why Us?

The Facilities Project Manager role offers the opportunity to manage meaningful capital projects that directly support the mission of UT MD Anderson. This position provides professional growth through exposure to complex facilities initiatives, stakeholder collaboration, regulatory compliance activities, and project leadership responsibilities while supporting a work environment committed to operational excellence and long-term career development.

Employer-paid medical coverage starting day one for employees working 30+ hours/week, plus optional group dental, vision, life, AD&D, and disability insurance.
Accruals for PTO and Extended Illness Bank, plus paid holidays, wellness, childcare, and other leave options.
Tuition Assistance Program after six months of service and access to extensive wellness, fitness, and employee resource groups.
Defined-benefit pension through the Teachers Retirement System, voluntary retirement plans, and employer-paid life and reduced salary protection programs.

Responsibilities

Project Management

Manage key project components including scope, budget, schedule, and contract compliance
Ensure projects are completed on schedule, within approved budgets, and in accordance with applicable quality standards
Guide and oversee project teams including customers, General Contractors, Construction Managers, consultants, Capital Planning & Management resources, and Facilities Management Division groups
Facilitate productive project activities through conflict resolution and effective written and verbal communication
Coordinate project stakeholders to ensure successful project completion
Assist with management of complex major projects and independently manage less complex capital facility projects
Demonstrate project management skills in project integration and coordination efforts
Delegate project activities and manage stakeholder relationships throughout the project lifecycle
Manage scope, schedules, costs, quality assurance, and changing project priorities

Compliance/Regulations

Manage contractual compliance and maintain relationships for assigned projects
Define and implement contractual and financial strategies supporting project objectives
Coordinate approval procedures with the BOR, THECB, FSC, and associated state agencies
Collaborate with Supply Chain Services to prepare documentation required for contract awards
Support the ROCIP on selected projects
Ensure compliance with current institutional and industry standards

Documentation/Recordkeeping

Develop and maintain project documentation that is accurate, current, clear, and complete
Manage project records, financial reports, activity reports, and project status reporting
Support decision-making and issue-resolution processes through effective documentation practices
Organize and properly store project records and documentation
Manage project information generation, collection, dissemination, storage, and disposition

Technical & Operational Leadership

Apply knowledge of construction processes, product applications, and building and infrastructure component assembly
Coordinate project elements across multiple stakeholders and disciplines
Manage communication processes throughout project execution
Support quality assurance activities and project performance objectives
Perform other duties as assigned

EDUCATION

Required: Bachelor's Degree Construction Management, Construction Science, Architectural Engineering or related field.

Work Experience

Required: 3 years Project management/construction management experience.
May substitute Bachelor's degree with additional years of equivalent experience on a one to one basis.
Preferred: 5 years Project management/construction management experience. Design and construction experience with major academic healthcare and/or research facility.

The University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center offers excellent benefits, including medical, dental, paid time off, retirement, tuition benefits, educational opportunities, and individual and team recognition.

jobs.description:
Entra nel nostro mondo

Quale sarà la tua sfida?

Sarai parte attiva della crescita della practice Tech&Telco
che supporta sin dal nostro ingresso sul mercato i principali player di riferimento del settore telco, finance, retail e molto altro. Aiutiamo ai nostri clienti nella gestione e governance di progetti digital, innovativi e di performance improvement, supportandoli anche nell’ottimizzazione di processi trasversali. Insieme a loro definiamo un’appropriata strategia tecnologica, accompagnandoli durante le fasi di progettazione e di implementazione. Grazie alle nostre competenze multidisciplinari, possiamo migliorare le loro operations, utilizzando metodologie di Task Automation o di Process Reengineering. Sarai coinvolto in progetti di evoluzione processi e strumenti a supporto del business aziendale. Dovrai supportare la funzione IT nella attività di Governance delle iniziative di evoluzione degli applicativi aziendali garantendo rispetto dei tempi ed il coordinamento di tutte le iniziative.

Project Manager IT - Lead Consultant

Sarai tu ad entrare nel nostro Team?

Hai l’abilità di pensare “out of the box”, hai voglia di mettere in campo le tue idee e le tue capacità, ti piace lavorare con gli altri, sei una persona determinata e ti appassionano innovazione e tecnologie?

Requisiti per la posizione:

 Hai maturato almeno 5 anni
nella governance di complessi progetti IT e ti senti a tuo agio nella gestione e coordinamento di risorse interne ed esterne;
Ti sai prendere cura a 360° della vita di un progetto e delle sue principali caratteristiche – ambito, tempi e costi – in accordo alle metodologie standard di PM (certificazioni Prince, PMP, ITIL sono un plus);
Conosci le fasi del ciclo di vita del software nelle sue diverse declinazioni (Waterfall, Agile) e i principali modelli architetturali IT (On-premise, Cloud SaaS, PaaS, etc.);
Sei in grado di interloquire sia con stakeholder di Business sia con tecnici IT e system integrator per il raggiungimento degli obiettivi complessivi delle iniziative progettuali.

Sede: Milano

Cosa offriamo

La retribuzione prevista per il grade Lead Consultant
è compresa tra € 38.000
e € 46.000
e sarà commisurata in funzione dell'esperienza, delle competenze e del livello di seniority del candidato.

L'inquadramento sarà definito durante il processo di selezione sulla base del profilo individuato e nel rispetto della normativa e del CCNL Metalmeccanici Industria.

La retribuzione indicata si riferisce alla sola RAL (Retribuzione Annua Lorda)
. 

Il pacchetto complessivo può includere ulteriori componenti variabili, correlate al raggiungimento di specifici obiettivi individuali e/o aziendali, welfare e benefit aziendali. La proposta economica finale sarà definita in base alle caratteristiche del profilo selezionato e alla coerenza con i requisiti della posizione.

Perché scegliere BIP

In BIP mettiamo le persone al centro. Offriamo un ambiente sfidante e meritocratico, dove la collaborazione e lo spirito imprenditoriale vengono valorizzati ogni giorno.

Crescita e Formazione

Più di 300 corsi su tecnologie e business emergenti, programmi di sviluppo personalizzati e iniziative di training e people care per supportare la tua crescita professionale e personale;
Flessibilità e Work-Life Integration

Lavoro agile con possibilità di programmare le giornate da remoto e in ufficio con il proprio responsabile e in base alle esigenze di progetto, Banca Ore Solidale per usufruire o mettere a disposizione ore di permesso a colleghi e colleghe che vivono momenti di difficoltà e una cultura che favorisce l’equilibrio tra vita e lavoro;
Salute & Benefits

Assicurazione sanitaria, check-up agevolati, piattaforme per il benessere psicofisico e un piano welfare integrativo. Ticket restaurant e altri benefit dedicati;
Famiglia e Genitorialità

Supporto concreto a neogenitori: integrazione al 100% per i primi 3 mesi del congedo parentale o bonus una tantum, giorni extra per i papà e iniziative di supporto durante il congedo e al rientro in azienda;
Inclusione e Valori

Promuoviamo l’unicità e garantiamo pari opportunità a tutte le persone. Lavoriamo per un ambiente etico, equo e accogliente, anche attraverso politiche attive per le categorie protette (L. 68/99).

Next Steps

Una volta ricevuto il tuo cv ci prenderemo del tempo per valutarlo attentamente. Se c’è un match con questa o con altre posizioni aperte all’interno del Gruppo, ti contatteremo per iniziare la nostra conoscenza reciproca. L’iter di selezione comprende generalmente un colloquio con HR, un colloquio tecnico con un line manager ed un eventuale colloquio con un Partner. L’ordine e il numero delle interviste potrebbero variare a seconda delle esigenze di recruiting. In alternativa, saremo felici di conservare il tuo CV nel nostro database per poterlo rivalutare per altre opportunità future. Se dovessi identificare ulteriori posizioni di tuo interesse ed in linea con il tuo profilo, aspettiamo la tua candidatura per poterla valutare nuovamente.

Trasforma insieme a noi

Nati nel 2003, abbiamo raccolto e valorizzato l’esperienza storica della consulenza e abbiamo aggiunto due ingredienti chiave: l’innovazione e la digitalizzazione. Grazie a questo percorso siamo oggi più di 6500 professionisti e professioniste, presenti in 14 Paesi, con oltre 4500 progetti alle spalle e le conoscenze più all’avanguardia nell'ambito della Digital Transformation, Data Science, Cybersecurity, Industry 4.0, IOT e di tutte le Disruptive Technologies che mettiamo a servizio di ogni settore di mercato. Aiutiamo i nostri clienti a fare la differenza creando qualità su larga scala attraverso una formula che opera su tre leve: Valore, Persone e Tecnologia. Crediamo nel valore dell’eccellenza, che è la bussola su cui orientiamo il nostro agire, e adottiamo un approccio etico e leale nei confronti di quante e quanti scelgono di lavorare con noi, promuovendo un ambiente in cui le persone possano crescere insieme, grazie alla contaminazione tra competenze diverse.

Title: Project Manager - US Shift

Location:
JP Nagar, Bangalore

About Izmo

izmocars (www.izmoltd.com / www.izmocars.com) is a leading Interactive Media and Internet Solutions company with a strong presence in the Automotive industry. With Interactive Media studios in Long Beach, CA & Brussels, Europe, we are the largest producers of automotive content in the world. Our products include Interactive Media Solutions for Automotive, Web Platform, CRM, Online Marketing and Virtual Reality Platform for the Automotive industry.

The Project Manager for the US market owns the delivery of projects and the health of customer relationships for our US dealership clients. You are the single point of accountability between our US customers and our delivery, development, creative and marketing teams in India. You will lead the Customer Success Manager on the US night shift, set priorities, and make sure every commitment made to a customer is planned, tracked and delivered on time.

We are looking for someone who takes ownership, thinks in a structured way, is proactive and curious, and adapts quickly. We value character and a learning mindset over narrow tactical specialization. If you are a credible, organized problem-solver, we can teach you our products and the dealership business.

Job Description & Duties

Project delivery: Own end-to-end delivery of US client projects, including website and CMS builds, integrations, feed and marketing setups, and product rollouts, from scoping through go-live and handover.
Planning and governance: Define scope, milestones, dependencies and timelines. Maintain project plans, risk and issue logs, and status reports. Run sprint planning, stand-ups and retrospectives using Agile practices suited to each project.
Client management: Act as the senior point of contact for US customers. Run kickoff meetings, status calls and project reviews, set realistic expectations, and manage scope changes and escalations with clarity and confidence.
Team leadership: Lead, coach and set goals for the Customer Success Manager. Review account health, prioritise the escalation queue, remove blockers and support their growth.
Cross-functional coordination: Coordinate with development, QA, design, SEO, paid media and product teams in India. Translate customer needs into clear requirements and acceptance criteria, and make sure teams have what they need to deliver.
Cross-timezone operations: Design clean handoffs between the US-hours team and the India day team, so work moves forward every day with no dropped threads.
Risk management: Identify delivery, quality and relationship risks early. Put mitigation and recovery plans in place, and protect customer satisfaction and retention.
Metrics and reporting: Track delivery KPIs such as on-time delivery, turnaround time, customer satisfaction and escalation volume. Report to leadership on progress, risks and decisions needed.
Growth support: Work with the customer success and sales teams to spot expansion opportunities and support proposals, estimates and statements of work.
Continuous improvement: Use AI-assisted tools to improve planning, reporting, documentation and customer communication, and share what works with the team.

Mandatory / Primary Skills

8 12 years of experience in project, program or delivery management, including at least 2 years leading a team or managing client-facing delivery.
Proven experience working with US customers and managing delivery across time zones.
Strong command of Agile, Scrum or hybrid delivery methods. Certification such as PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM or SAFe is a plus.
Hands-on experience with project and delivery tools such as Jira, Confluence, Asana or similar, and a working understanding of CI/CD and release processes.
Excellent spoken and written English, with the ability to present confidently to customers and senior stakeholders.
Strong planning, prioritisation, negotiation and conflict-resolution skills.
Willingness to work US-aligned hours on a sustained basis.
A master s/bachelor's degree business, computer science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice To Have

Experience in SaaS, digital agency or automotive retail environments, including dealership websites, CRM or DMS integrations.
Familiarity with digital marketing delivery (SEO, Google Ads, Meta, feed-based advertising) and web analytics such as GA4.
Experience using AI tools to improve delivery, reporting or customer communication.
Experience managing customer success or support teams.

Success Criteria

US projects are delivered on time, within scope and to the customer's expectations.
Customers describe izmocars as organised, transparent and dependable.
Escalations are resolved quickly, and the same issue does not return twice.
The Customer Success Manager is confident, well-supported and growing in the role.
Day and night teams work as one, with clear handoffs and no surprises

jobs.title: IT Security Manager
jobs.description:
SimplifyNext is a Singapore-headquartered digital engineering firm, with offices in Thailand and Malaysia, working across three converged areas: agentic AI, AI-enabled application modernisation, and intelligent automation.

We bring strong business process consulting together with deep technology skills and modern delivery practices – product-centric, agile and AI-assisted. We build bespoke applications and AI systems, and we go deep on the platforms our clients run on, including Microsoft, AWS, ServiceNow, Databricks and UiPath. That combination of engineering depth and platform depth is what our clients come to us for.

We build and modernise the systems people depend on daily. Our 300+ practitioners are multi-disciplinary by design – business consultants, software engineers, architects, AI engineers and designers working on the same delivery, not handing off between silos. We focus on delivering outcomes for clients, building strong careers for our people, and staying ahead of the technology curve. We hire because we are growing.
The IT Security Manager is the customer-facing security lead and trusted advisor for the applications and AI-enabled solutions we deliver, accountable for their overall IT security posture. Working closely with customers, project teams and independent security partners, you will coordinate threat modelling, risk assessments, security testing and audits, with the technical depth to assess specialist work and act on the results. This role goes beyond back-office compliance – you will help shape how security supports innovation and strong governance in high-security, regulated environments.

What You'll Own

Customer Security Leadership

Serve as the primary security contact and trusted advisor, liaising between customers, delivery teams and independent security partners.
Report security status and risks to customers and management, with overall accountability for the IT security of delivered systems.

Security Planning & Partner Oversight

Plan and coordinate security activities across the project lifecycle, including threat modelling, risk assessments, security testing and audits.
Assess the quality and accuracy of work produced by independent security partners, such as threat models and test reports, and follow up on gaps.

Risk Management & Documentation

Conduct IT security risk assessments jointly with customers, propose mitigation measures for approval, and maintain the risk register.
Prepare and maintain security documentation, including security plans, design documents, policies and procedures.

Secure Design & Standards

Ensure systems meet customer-approved security requirements and recognised standards, from design through testing.
Advise delivery teams on secure design for cloud-first and AI-enabled solutions.

Remediation & Incident Response

Consolidate findings from security assessments and testing, and drive their timely remediation and closure.
Coordinate security incident handling and act as the primary point of contact for security escalations.

What You'll Bring

Must-Have

At least 5 years of experience in IT security, covering enterprise systems, networks or cloud infrastructure.
Experience in security risk assessment, security governance, incident response, vulnerability assessment and security testing.
Sound technical knowledge of application, infrastructure and cloud security, enough to evaluate threat models, assessment reports and test results.
Experience coordinating with customers, vendors and third-party security providers.
Good knowledge of security standards and best practices such as ISO/IEC 27001, NIST and CIS.
A current professional security certification such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, CISA or CRISC.
Strong written, presentation and stakeholder management skills.
Able to support security incident response outside office hours when required.

Good-to-Have

Exposure to DevSecOps practices and the security of AI-enabled solutions.
Prior experience in a similar role in the Singapore Public Sector, including familiarity with government ICT security policies.

This role is not a fit if:

You prefer back-office compliance work rather than being customer-facing on live delivery.
You want a purely hands-on testing role rather than coordinating and assessing the work of specialist partners.
You see security as a gate that slows delivery rather than something that enables it.
You're uncomfortable being the primary point of contact for security escalations, including outside office hours

Why SimplifyNext

One Team, Not Siloed Offerings

Apps, automation, and AI aren't separate teams here - you'll work across all three as one connected practice, not get boxed into a single lane.

AI in Our DNA, Not Bolted On

Regardless of platform, every specialist here is AI-enabled by design, powered by our own in-house AI workbench that pairs humans and AI from discovery to testing.

Future-Proof Your Career

Tech trends come and go - today's hot platform is tomorrow's afterthought. We multi-skill our people across platforms and AI so your career keeps growing no matter where the market moves.

APAC's Biggest AI-Integrated Practice

Across every platform we work in, our AI-integrated practice is the largest in the region, with work good enough to be cited at Google's own AI event.

Grow With Us Across ASEAN

We're one of Singapore's 100 Fastest Growing Companies, expanding fast across Thailand and Malaysia - plenty of room to grow with us.

At SimplifyNext, we’re committed to building a team of curious, driven, and forward-thinking individuals who care deeply about creating meaningful impact through technology. If you’re excited by the opportunity to grow, collaborate, and shape the future of digital transformation across the region, we’d be happy to hear from you.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Solar
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Project Manager – Solar who can independently visit project sites, assess site conditions, plan execution activities, coordinate manpower and materials, and ensure the successful completion of solar projects.

This is a field-based travelling role
, not a desk job. The candidate will be required to travel regularly to customer locations and project sites, oversee on-ground execution, coordinate with vendors and installation teams, resolve site-level challenges, and ensure projects are completed within the committed timelines and quality standards.
The ideal candidate should have strong technical knowledge of solar installations, excellent execution and coordination skills, and the ability to take complete ownership of projects from site assessment through commissioning and handover.

Key Responsibilities

1. Site Visits & Execution Planning

Travel regularly to assigned project sites to assess site conditions and plan execution activities.
Conduct site inspections and evaluate installation feasibility, manpower requirements, material availability, and technical challenges.
Prepare site-wise execution plans, timelines, resource plans, and project milestones.
Identify potential execution risks and resolve site-level challenges proactively.
Coordinate with customers and site stakeholders before commencing installation activities.

2. End-to-End Solar Project Execution

Take ownership of solar projects from site assessment and planning through installation, testing, commissioning, and final handover.
Supervise on-site installation of solar modules, mounting structures, inverters, cabling, earthing, and associated electrical systems.
Ensure execution is carried out according to approved designs, technical specifications, and project schedules.
Monitor daily site progress and ensure activities are completed as planned.
Take immediate corrective action when execution delays or technical issues arise.

3. Manpower & Contractor Management

Coordinate and manage technicians, installation teams, contractors, subcontractors, and site supervisors.
Allocate work based on project priorities, manpower availability, and execution schedules.
Monitor workforce productivity, attendance, work quality, and completion timelines.
Ensure the installation team follows the approved execution plan and safety requirements.
Resolve manpower-related issues that could affect project progress.

4. Material & Vendor Coordination

Plan material requirements before project execution begins.
Coordinate with procurement, vendors, and warehouse teams to ensure timely availability of solar modules, inverters, structures, cables, and other materials.
Verify material availability and condition at the site.
Track material consumption, shortages, wastage, and delivery schedules.
Prevent project delays caused by inadequate planning or material unavailability.

5. Project Timeline & Cost Management

Prepare and monitor project execution schedules with clear milestones and target completion dates.
Ensure projects are completed within approved timelines and budgets.
Track site expenses, contractor costs, material consumption, and resource utilization.
Identify delays, cost overruns, and execution bottlenecks and take corrective action.
Provide regular progress updates to management.

6. Quality Control & Safety

Conduct regular site inspections to verify installation quality and adherence to approved drawings.
Ensure compliance with applicable electrical safety standards and company procedures.
Monitor the use of PPE and safe working practices by all site personnel.
Identify installation defects, non-conformities, and rework requirements and ensure timely resolution.
Ensure proper testing, commissioning, and documentation before project handover.

7. Customer & Stakeholder Coordination

Coordinate with customers, vendors, contractors, internal teams, and other stakeholders at project sites.
Provide updates on project progress, execution timelines, and pending activities.
Resolve site-related customer concerns and technical issues promptly.
Coordinate required inspections, approvals, net-metering processes, and DISCOM-related activities, as applicable.
Ensure a smooth customer handover after successful project completion.

8. Reporting & Documentation

Submit daily site progress reports, including work completed, manpower deployed, materials used, and pending activities.
Maintain site visit records, project trackers, photographs, inspection reports, and execution documentation.
Report delays, risks, technical issues, and resource requirements to management immediately.
Maintain records of testing, commissioning, warranties, and final project handover.

Required Skills & Qualifications

B.Tech or Diploma in Electrical Engineering or a related technical field.
5–8 years of experience in solar project execution, preferably in solar EPC or rooftop solar installations.
Strong hands-on experience in managing site execution and installation teams.
Good understanding of solar PV systems, inverters, modules, mounting structures, electrical cabling, earthing, and commissioning.
Proven ability to plan site execution, manpower deployment, material requirements, and project schedules.
Experience managing contractors, vendors, technicians, and customer-site coordination.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make decisions independently at project sites.
Good communication, leadership, reporting, and coordination skills.
Willingness to travel extensively across assigned regions and stay at project locations when required.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Timely completion of solar projects against approved execution schedules.
Quality and accuracy of site execution and installation.
Effective site planning and manpower utilization.
Timely identification and resolution of site-level issues.
Availability of materials and resources before execution deadlines.
Compliance with safety standards and reduction in rework.
Accuracy and timeliness of daily site reports.
Customer satisfaction and successful project handover.

Description

About Cyera

Come join the company building the security operating model for the age of AI. AI has changed how data is used — and security must change with it. Cyera's mission is to empower businesses to accelerate AI Adoption by defining a holistic approach to securing AI - from data to access to model. Instead of perimeter controls and static policies, Cyera provides a unified control plane that understands relationships between data, access, and behaviors across humans, systems, and AI. Backed by the world’s leading investors and working with a large and growing list of Fortune 1000 companies, we are looking for world-class talent to join us as we usher in the new era of data and AI security.

About The Team

The Competitive Intelligence team is responsible for analyzing the competitive landscape across the market. The team focuses on understanding how competitor products work, evaluating technical claims, and identifying strengths, gaps, and risks. It works closely with Product Management, R&D, Sales, and Marketing to provide evidence-based insights that support product decisions, competitive positioning, and customer conversations.

The team’s output includes technical analyses, competitive reports, and materials used across the company to inform strategy and execution.

About The Role

We seek a highly skilled Technical Competitive Intelligence Analyst
to analyze and evaluate competitors' products. This role includes understanding our competitors' technical landscapes and providing insights that inform Cyera's product roadmap, enhance our competitive positioning, and drive innovation in data security solutions.

What You’ll Do

Analyze identity security products in depth, including their architectures, technology stacks, and key features across NHI, agentic identity, IGA, and adjacent PAM and ISPM.
Gather and synthesize competitive intelligence from field input, customer feedback, analyst reports, call intelligence, CRM data, and public sources to assess competitor claims and understand which vendors appear in deals, at what stage, and how we win.

jobs.description:
About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

The ANZ Marketplace team owns the health of our ride-hailing marketplace across Australia and New Zealand — spanning trading efficiency, rider and driver experience, and risk & anti-fraud strategy. We work close to the business: diagnosing what's driving our core metrics, designing strategies from the ground up, and validating them in the real world. This role sits at the intersection of business and operations, with plenty of room to shape decisions that directly affect the experience of riders and drivers.

In this role, you'll be...

Develop a deep understanding of our ride-hailing marketplace — identify problems, get to the root cause behind movements in core business metrics (trading efficiency, rider/driver experience, etc.), and deliver optimisation recommendations backed by sound business judgement
Break down business situations in rider experience and operations (cancellation fees, cleaning fees, routing & toll disputes, driver misconduct, etc.), turning vague business phenomena into clear, actionable problems
Use data (data pulling, metric monitoring, and experiment validation where needed) to support business decisions, judge whether strategies are effective, and drive iteration
Capture analytical conclusions and business methodology into the team's ops tracker / knowledge base, improving how efficiently the team understands the business
Collaborate with Product, Operations, Risk and other cross-functional teams to drive project delivery across the Beijing and ANZ time zones

We're eager to be in touch because you have...

Bachelor's degree or above; discipline open, with a quantitative background (statistics, mathematics, actuarial studies, computer science, economics, engineering etc.) preferred
1–3 years of experience in operations / business analysis / strategy (outstanding new or recent graduates will also be considered)
Strong business understanding and logical judgement — able to independently break down ambiguous requirements into a clear analytical framework and reach conclusions with real commercial sense
Strong learner, highly proactive, able to make progress even when information is incomplete
Good written and verbal communication in both English and Chinese, comfortable collaborating across cross-functional teams

You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a curious and detail-oriented Data Analyst who enjoys working with data and turning it into meaningful insights. In this role, you’ll help us understand what the numbers are telling us, identify trends, and provide information that helps the team make better decisions.

You’ll work closely with different teams to understand their needs, solve business problems, and present findings in a clear and practical way. We’re looking for someone who is comfortable asking questions, enjoys solving problems, and can explain data in a way that makes sense to both technical and non-technical colleagues.

Key Responsibilities

Collect, clean, organize, and analyze data from different sources to ensure accuracy and reliability.
Work with business teams to understand their goals, challenges, and reporting needs.
Create and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Excel.
Use SQL to retrieve, manipulate, and analyze data from databases.
Identify patterns, trends, and potential issues that can help improve business performance.
Translate complex data into clear insights and practical recommendations.
Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and prepare regular reports for stakeholders.
Investigate data discrepancies and work with relevant teams to resolve them.
Support business planning and decision-making through data-driven analysis.
Look for opportunities to improve reporting processes, data quality, and analytical workflows.

Skills And Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Good working knowledge of SQL and data analysis techniques.
Experience with Excel and at least one data visualization tool, such as Power BI or Tableau.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an eye for detail.
Ability to interpret data, recognize trends, and explain findings clearly.
Good communication skills and the ability to work with people across different teams.
A willingness to learn new tools, ask questions, and explore better ways of working.
Ability to manage multiple tasks, meet deadlines, and maintain accuracy in day-to-day work.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means more than preparing reports. It means helping the team understand what is happening in the business and why. You’ll be successful when your analysis answers important questions, your reports are reliable and easy to understand, and your insights help people make informed decisions.

What We’re Looking For

We value someone who is thoughtful, dependable, and genuinely interested in understanding data. You don’t need to have every answer right away, but you should be comfortable exploring problems, learning from feedback, and working with others to find the right answers.

If you enjoy connecting the dots, finding meaning in numbers, and helping people make better decisions, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.location: Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
About Phi Partners

Phi Partners has been a trusted capital markets consultancy for more than 20 years, providing quantitative and technology expertise across front office, pricing and risk. We support more than 80 financial institutions across the buy-side and sell-side through niche capabilities spanning quant, engineering, vendor platforms and cloud infrastructure.
Our teams work on complex, real-world problems across models, analytics, applications, data and cloud infrastructure, within an international delivery organisation built around regional hubs and specialist centres of excellence. For people who enjoy technically demanding work in capital markets, Phi offers the opportunity to work closely with expert colleagues and major financial institutions on high-value, business-critical initiatives.

About the Programme

We are supporting one of the world’s largest institutional investors, a global sovereign wealth fund investing across public and private markets. The opportunity sits within the client’s Public Markets Data team, which supports the investment business across risk data, including counterparty credit risk, market risk, margining and collateral, as well as market data and trade execution. The client is consolidating its data capabilities onto Databricks as an enterprise-level data platform, making this a key area of its broader technology and data strategy.
Phi Partners is looking for a Techno-Functional Business Analyst to act as the bridge between the investment business and the data engineering teams. This is not a traditional, analysis-only BA role: the successful candidate will also be expected to work hands-on with the data and the pipelines behind it. The role will initially focus on one of the team’s key areas, with the opportunity to develop broader knowledge across the Public Markets Data function over time. The client understands that candidates may not have deep knowledge of every area from day one and will support the successful candidate in building it.
As an example of the work, a front-office or compliance team might ask for a new metric on an existing dashboard, such as a 36-month rolling beta. The Business Analyst would trace where the underlying time-series data comes from and what it represents, work out how the metric should be derived, and specify it so a data engineer can build it directly.

Roles and Responsibilities

The successful candidate will work at the intersection of investment data, business analysis and technology, helping stakeholders turn complex data requirements into practical solutions. The role requires someone who can investigate problems independently, understand the underlying financial and technical context, and work effectively across business and engineering teams.
Key Responsibilities:
Gather and translate requirements from Front Office and business stakeholders into clear technical and data specifications
Analyse datasets, data flows and dependencies, defining source-to-target mappings, transformations, data models and data quality requirements
Work hands-on with Databricks, Spark and SQL to profile data, develop or review pipelines, investigate issues and validate outputs
Create lightweight prototypes where required to help stakeholders visualise and refine reporting or data solutions
Manage a personal Book of Work across multiple smaller workstreams, independently investigating requirements and proposing solutions
Work closely with Data Engineers and business stakeholders throughout delivery, ensuring effective communication between business and technology teams

Key Skills

Mandatory skills include:
Minimum five years as a Business Analyst or BA/PM, with substantial data engineering experience and delivery on projects in the financial domain
Hands-on Python and PySpark coding experience, ideally on Databricks, is essential
Advanced SQL (complex joins, window functions, reconciliations) for in-depth data analysis
Good understanding of financial markets and investment concepts across buy side and sell side, ideally with exposure to security master, reference data, market data, the trade lifecycle or other investment-related data
High-level understanding of risk modelling and instrument pricing: how an instrument is priced and how risk is measured, without needing quant-level depth
Experience working with structured financial data and data modelling concepts
Comfortable working directly with front-office users and using their terminology
Ability to manage several workstreams in parallel with limited supervision
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, able to explain technical design to investment professionals and investment concepts to engineers
Bachelor’s degree in IT, Finance, Engineering or a related field

Nice to Have Skills:
Domain exposure to trade execution, counterparty credit risk, market risk, or margining and collateral
Experience with the Azure data stack and Azure DevOps
Experience with Power BI or an equivalent BI tool
Databricks certification or an investment qualification such as CFA (any level) or IMC
Previous experience at a sovereign wealth fund, large asset manager or investment bank

Next steps

This is an opportunity to join a growing capital markets consultancy and work within the data team of one of the world’s largest institutional investors. The role offers close exposure to front-office stakeholders and the chance to build broad knowledge across investment data while staying hands-on technically. If you are interested, please send a copy of your up-to-date CV to ashutosh.pawar@phipartners.com. We look forward to discussing the role with you in more detail.

jobs.description:
About The Company

DZ PRIVATBANK is the competence center for Private Banking and an important provider of fund services and loans in all currencies within the cooperative financial network of Volksbanken Raiffeisenbanken. The bank specializes in sophisticated, tailored solutions for Private Banking clients. Its services range from traditional asset management and wealth structuring to financial advice, financial and retirement planning, and foundation advisory services.

About The Role

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will take responsibility for the continued development and optimization of reporting production. You will work across the full reporting lifecycle, from conceptual analysis and regulatory assessment through process design and technical implementation. This role combines specialist knowledge of investment fund reporting requirements with data analysis, quality assurance, stakeholder communication, and project leadership.

You will help ensure that reports meet applicable regulatory requirements while also addressing individual client needs. Working closely with colleagues and external stakeholders, you will identify opportunities to improve reporting processes and put sustainable, quality-focused solutions into practice. Your expertise will help the team respond effectively to changing regulations, evolving data needs, and new technologies.

Qualifications

You have completed a degree in finance, economics, business mathematics, business informatics, or a comparable field. You bring at least five years of relevant experience and strong expertise in investment fund reporting regulation. Your knowledge includes applicable requirements and reporting considerations in areas such as AIFMD, PRIIPs, Solvency, or CRR.

You have well-developed analytical skills related to big data and the associated technology landscape. Familiarity with programming languages is an advantage. You communicate confidently in German at C1 or C2 level and in English, enabling you to engage with colleagues and external stakeholders in both languages.

You are comfortable taking ownership of complex topics and contributing your expertise within a qualified, collaborative team. A structured, careful, and independent working style is important, along with flexibility, a solution-oriented mindset, sound judgment, and the ability to understand new subject matter quickly. You are curious about innovation and motivated to use it to improve working practices and outcomes.

Responsibilities

Develop and optimize reporting production from initial analysis and conceptual design through technical implementation. Design regulatory and individually tailored reports, assess relevant regulatory developments, and translate requirements into appropriate reporting adjustments. Contribute to the ongoing improvement of processes involved in report preparation, with attention to efficiency, accuracy, and dependable delivery.

Establish and implement suitable quality assurance measures to support the consistency and reliability of reporting outputs. Lead interdisciplinary projects, coordinate contributions across relevant teams, and help keep initiatives aligned with their objectives. Participate in communication with clients, competent authorities, and involved service providers, ensuring that reporting topics and requirements are addressed clearly and professionally.

Benefits

This position offers the opportunity to contribute to specialist reporting work within an established private banking and financial services organization. You will work with experienced colleagues on challenging regulatory and data-related topics, take meaningful responsibility, and contribute to the continued development of reporting processes. The role also provides scope to apply your expertise, collaborate across disciplines, and engage with innovation in your area of work.

Equal Opportunity

DZ PRIVATBANK is committed to a respectful and inclusive workplace. Employment decisions are based on role-related qualifications, experience, and business needs. We welcome applications from qualified candidates and value the different perspectives and expertise they bring to our teams.

Description

As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon’s unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers’ businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon’s real-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no-brainers to buy and easy to use.

Amazon Connect is an AI-powered customer experience solution that enables superior outcomes at a lower cost. Since its 2017 public launch, Amazon Connect has become an AI leader, transforming how organizations of all types interact with their customers.

Amazon Connect is a highly disruptive cloud-based contact center that enables businesses to deliver engaging, dynamic, and personal customer service experiences. Amazon Connect is the result of the ten years of development that went into building the tools Amazon uses to provide its award winning customer service at massive scale and launching it as a publicly available AWS service. With Amazon Connect, you can create your own cloud-based contact center and be taking calls in minutes. Amazon Connect leverages the power of Artificial Intelligence and the large ecosystem of AWS services such as Amazon Lex, Amazon Polly, AWS Lambda, Amazon S3 and Amazon Kinesis to provide a truly frustration free, easy-to-use, extensible, and natural customer experience. With this technology, we are transforming an industry and the way customers interact with businesses and how agents service them.

We are looking for passionate and talented Technical Program Manager to join us to innovate on this new service that addresses customer needs to build modern contact centers in the cloud. The position represents a rare opportunity to be a part of a fast-growing business soon after launch, and help shape the technology and product as we grow. You will be playing a crucial role in developing the next generation contact center, and get the opportunity to design and deliver scaleable, resilient systems while maintaining a constant customer focus.

We are looking for a highly effective Senior Technical Program Manager that can lead a team to quickly design and deliver systems while maintaining a constant customer focus.

The Technical Program Manager for this team needs a sound understanding of the fundamentals of communications and practical experience building large-scale distributed systems. If you become the Senior Technical Program Manager, you will work with design, technical, and business leaders to set strategy and define the product. You will drive, track, and report the development effort to leadership and partners. You will define the engagement model and manage internal/external dependencies and relationships. You will be key leader responsible for delivering the distributed systems and analytics that will enable AWS to continue changing the software industry by delivering more capabilities to more customers.

This team is a great fit for you if

You enjoy working with a fun team that prides itself on a great work environment with an inclusive group of people that are working together towards a common goal.
You are sensitive to customer needs and interested in working on a service that will be used, directly and indirectly, by millions of customers and has a meaningful impact to their functions and interactions.
You’d like to be directly responsible for solving real customer problems.
You are a passionate learner and are motivated to take on new challenges.
You want to have fun; surround yourself with a highly talented pool of engineers that like to solve complex problems, but also enjoy work life balance.

Coordinate closely with site engineers, consultants, subcontractors, and suppliers to ensure smooth execution.
Ensure construction work is executed in line with approved drawings, method statements, and specifications.
2. Contract Review & Site Implementation:

Review contracts, technical documents, drawings, and specifications from an execution perspective.
Ensure site execution aligns with contractual requirements and project scope.
Monitor contractor performance and enforce compliance with contract terms on site.
3. Claims, Variations & Site Issues Management:

Resolve site disputes proactively to avoid delays and disruptions.
Coordinate with consultants and legal teams when required.

Manage and implement change orders arising from site conditions.
Ensure all changes are properly documented and communicated to all stakeholders.

Control material usage, manpower allocation, and equipment deployment on site.
Support cost estimation for variations and additional works based on site realities.

Ensure clear task allocation, supervision, and performance tracking on site.
Conduct daily/weekly site coordination meetings and progress reviews.

Enforce HSE standards across all site activities.

Maintain detailed site records including daily reports, progress updates, and site instructions.

Document site lessons learned for continuous improvement.

One cloud for compute, inference, and agents.

The Role

You are the operational backbone behind our largest sales opportunities. You own end-to-end program execution for strategic deals, from initial BD and term sheet through contracting, financing, infrastructure build-out, and customer go-live.
You will be the single point of coordination between Sales, Finance, Legal, Tax, Corporate Development, and Infrastructure. You keep complex, multi-stakeholder deals moving, surface risks early, and give leadership a clear, honest view of where every program stands.

Stakeholder management

Act as a trusted partner to internal leaders and, when needed, to customers, data center partners, and financing counterparties.
Work through competing priorities and sensitive conversations with good judgment and emotional intelligence.
Bridge communication between US-based teams and Mandarin-speaking stakeholders and partners.

Required

5+ years of professional experience in program management, deal management, PMO, strategy and operations, or a related role.

Experience with Salesforce/HubSpot, Asana/Jira/Smartsheet, and building dashboards.

You have a complete view of the strategic deal pipeline, a working weekly review cadence, and trusted relationships with Finance, Legal, CorpDev, and Infra leads.

Strategic deals move faster from term sheet to signature to go-live. Leadership has real-time visibility, and fewer issues come as surprises.

You have built a scalable deal PMO function, with playbooks, tooling, and possibly a team.

jobs.title: Senior / Staff Technical Program Manager, AI Research
jobs.description:
At Rhoda AI, we’re building the next generation of generalist intelligent robots. We own the full robotics stack from high-performance hardware and robot systems to the infrastructure and state-of-the-art foundation world models that control our robots. Our robots are designed to be generalists capable of operating in complex, real-world environments and handling long-tail edge cases, made possible by our cutting edge research and end-to-end system design. We've raised over $450M and are investing aggressively in model research, infrastructure, hardware development, and manufacturing scale-up to make generalist robotics a reality.

The role

We're looking for a Senior/Staff Technical Program Manager, AI Research
to help scale how research programs come together at Rhoda. This is a deeply technical, cross-functional execution role at the intersection of pre-training, post-training, applied research, data, GPU infrastructure, robotic hardware, and customer-facing model delivery.

You'll own the integrated execution plan
across these efforts: connecting milestones, anticipating dependencies, driving blockers to resolution, and helping teams make timely resource and sequencing decisions. The objective is to give researchers and engineers more time to build, while making the path from research experiments to usable models more predictable.

You'll work closely with Research leadership, technical leads, infrastructure, robotics, and hardware teams. You won't need to invent the scientific roadmap yourself—but you should be technical enough to understand it, challenge assumptions constructively, and turn ambiguity into practical options.

What You'll Do

Build the integrated research roadmap. Translate individual project plans into a clear, continuously updated view of experiments, model and data readiness, system integrations, releases, dependencies, critical paths, and decision points.
Connect model development to downstream use. Coordinate the transitions from pre-training checkpoints to post-training, applied model engineering, evaluation, and deployment; align on handoff criteria, owners, and readiness expectations.
Synchronize data, compute, and hardware. Anticipate when training datasets, collection systems, robots, workcells, and GPU capacity need to be available; manage resource demand forecasts and routine scheduling trade-offs within agreed priorities.
Drive blockers to resolution. Identify cross-team gaps before they become delays, bring the right owners together, maintain action plans and contingencies, and escalate consequential trade-offs with a concrete recommendation.
Surface capacity and staffing risks early. Help research leaders understand where milestones need additional engineering capacity, specialized expertise, or reprioritization; support decisions without owning personnel management.
Build lightweight execution rhythms. Run focused program reviews, maintain decision and dependency logs, and create concise, reliable updates for technical leadership without burying researchers in process.
Manage uncertainty intelligently. Distinguish experiments, proof-of-concept demonstrations, engineering-readiness milestones, and customer-deployment commitments; track confidence and learning goals instead of forcing speculative research into false precision.
Improve cross-functional execution. Partner with hardware and operations TPMs and program leads to clarify interfaces, ownership, acceptance criteria, and release expectations as Rhoda scales.

What we're looking for

Significant technical program management experience delivering complex, interdependent work across software, ML, research infrastructure, robotics, or similarly technical organizations; senior or staff-level judgment.
Strong understanding of the machine learning development lifecycle, including datasets, model training, evaluation, iteration, and the practical challenges of moving models into production.
Demonstrated ability to build an execution system from an ambiguous starting point, identify true critical dependencies, and drive progress across teams without direct reporting authority.
Technical fluency sufficient to work credibly with researchers and infrastructure engineers, ask the right questions, and present real trade-offs—not just collect status.
Experience coordinating constrained engineering resources, such as compute capacity, test systems, labs, hardware platforms, or specialized teams.
Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to turn many threads of technical work into a concise, decision-ready view for leadership.
Sound judgment about when to solve a coordination issue independently, when to involve technical owners, and when a decision needs leadership attention.

Nice to have

Experience in large-scale model training, foundation models, generative models, computer vision, embodied AI, or robotics.
Familiarity with GPU clusters, data pipelines, robot testing and evaluation, or hardware/software integration.
Experience bridging research organizations and customer-facing applied engineering or model release functions.

Why this matters

Rhoda's capability roadmap spans faster task adaptation, instruction and demonstration following, higher execution speed, and dexterous manipulation. These breakthroughs depend on models, data, hardware, compute, and evaluation becoming ready in the right sequence. You'll help turn that complexity into a coherent execution engine—without slowing down the research itself.

Success in this role
means important handoffs are clear, blockers surface early, resource conflicts are resolved faster, technical teams spend less time coordinating across silos, and leadership has a trustworthy view of milestones and risks.

Promuoviamo l’unicità e garantiamo pari opportunità a tutte le persone. Lavoriamo per un ambiente etico, equo e accogliente, anche attraverso politiche attive per le categorie protette (L. 68/99).

Una volta ricevuto il tuo cv ci prenderemo del tempo per valutarlo attentamente. izmocars (www.izmoltd.com / www.izmocars.com) is a leading Interactive Media and Internet Solutions company with a strong presence in the Automotive industry.
