Our products include Interactive Media Solutions for Automotive, Web Platform, CRM, Online Marketing and Virtual Reality Platform for the Automotive industry.

The Project Manager for the US market owns the delivery of projects and the health of customer relationships for our US dealership clients. You are the single point of accountability between our US customers and our delivery, development, creative and marketing teams in India. You will lead the Customer Success Manager on the US night shift, set priorities, and make sure every commitment made to a customer is planned, tracked and delivered on time.

We are looking for someone who takes ownership, thinks in a structured way, is proactive and curious, and adapts quickly. We value character and a learning mindset over narrow tactical specialization. If you are a credible, organized problem-solver, we can teach you our products and the dealership business.

Job Description & Duties

Project delivery: Own end-to-end delivery of US client projects, including website and CMS builds, integrations, feed and marketing setups, and product rollouts, from scoping through go-live and handover.
Planning and governance: Define scope, milestones, dependencies and timelines. Maintain project plans, risk and issue logs, and status reports. Run sprint planning, stand-ups and retrospectives using Agile practices suited to each project.
Client management: Act as the senior point of contact for US customers. Run kickoff meetings, status calls and project reviews, set realistic expectations, and manage scope changes and escalations with clarity and confidence.
Team leadership: Lead, coach and set goals for the Customer Success Manager. Review account health, prioritise the escalation queue, remove blockers and support their growth.
Cross-functional coordination: Coordinate with development, QA, design, SEO, paid media and product teams in India. Translate customer needs into clear requirements and acceptance criteria, and make sure teams have what they need to deliver.
Cross-timezone operations: Design clean handoffs between the US-hours team and the India day team, so work moves forward every day with no dropped threads.
Risk management: Identify delivery, quality and relationship risks early. Put mitigation and recovery plans in place, and protect customer satisfaction and retention.
Metrics and reporting: Track delivery KPIs such as on-time delivery, turnaround time, customer satisfaction and escalation volume. Report to leadership on progress, risks and decisions needed.
Growth support: Work with the customer success and sales teams to spot expansion opportunities and support proposals, estimates and statements of work.
Continuous improvement: Use AI-assisted tools to improve planning, reporting, documentation and customer communication, and share what works with the team.

Mandatory / Primary Skills

8 12 years of experience in project, program or delivery management, including at least 2 years leading a team or managing client-facing delivery.
Proven experience working with US customers and managing delivery across time zones.
Strong command of Agile, Scrum or hybrid delivery methods. Certification such as PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM or SAFe is a plus.
Hands-on experience with project and delivery tools such as Jira, Confluence, Asana or similar, and a working understanding of CI/CD and release processes.
Excellent spoken and written English, with the ability to present confidently to customers and senior stakeholders.
Strong planning, prioritisation, negotiation and conflict-resolution skills.
Willingness to work US-aligned hours on a sustained basis.
A master s/bachelor's degree business, computer science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice To Have

Experience in SaaS, digital agency or automotive retail environments, including dealership websites, CRM or DMS integrations.
Familiarity with digital marketing delivery (SEO, Google Ads, Meta, feed-based advertising) and web analytics such as GA4.
Experience using AI tools to improve delivery, reporting or customer communication.
Experience managing customer success or support teams.

US projects are delivered on time, within scope and to the customer's expectations.
Customers describe izmocars as organised, transparent and dependable.
Escalations are resolved quickly, and the same issue does not return twice.
The Customer Success Manager is confident, well-supported and growing in the role.
Day and night teams work as one, with clear handoffs and no surprises

new_jobs.title: Project Manager - Solar
new_jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced and hands-on Project Manager – Solar who can independently visit project sites, assess site conditions, plan execution activities, coordinate manpower and materials, and ensure the successful completion of solar projects.

This is a field-based travelling role
, not a desk job. The candidate will be required to travel regularly to customer locations and project sites, oversee on-ground execution, coordinate with vendors and installation teams, resolve site-level challenges, and ensure projects are completed within the committed timelines and quality standards.
The ideal candidate should have strong technical knowledge of solar installations, excellent execution and coordination skills, and the ability to take complete ownership of projects from site assessment through commissioning and handover.

Key Responsibilities

1. Site Visits & Execution Planning

Travel regularly to assigned project sites to assess site conditions and plan execution activities.
Conduct site inspections and evaluate installation feasibility, manpower requirements, material availability, and technical challenges.
Prepare site-wise execution plans, timelines, resource plans, and project milestones.
Identify potential execution risks and resolve site-level challenges proactively.
Coordinate with customers and site stakeholders before commencing installation activities.

2. End-to-End Solar Project Execution

Take ownership of solar projects from site assessment and planning through installation, testing, commissioning, and final handover.
Supervise on-site installation of solar modules, mounting structures, inverters, cabling, earthing, and associated electrical systems.
Ensure execution is carried out according to approved designs, technical specifications, and project schedules.
Monitor daily site progress and ensure activities are completed as planned.
Take immediate corrective action when execution delays or technical issues arise.

3. Manpower & Contractor Management

Coordinate and manage technicians, installation teams, contractors, subcontractors, and site supervisors.
Allocate work based on project priorities, manpower availability, and execution schedules.
Monitor workforce productivity, attendance, work quality, and completion timelines.
Ensure the installation team follows the approved execution plan and safety requirements.
Resolve manpower-related issues that could affect project progress.

4. Material & Vendor Coordination

Plan material requirements before project execution begins.
Coordinate with procurement, vendors, and warehouse teams to ensure timely availability of solar modules, inverters, structures, cables, and other materials.
Verify material availability and condition at the site.
Track material consumption, shortages, wastage, and delivery schedules.
Prevent project delays caused by inadequate planning or material unavailability.

5. Project Timeline & Cost Management

Prepare and monitor project execution schedules with clear milestones and target completion dates.
Ensure projects are completed within approved timelines and budgets.
Track site expenses, contractor costs, material consumption, and resource utilization.
Identify delays, cost overruns, and execution bottlenecks and take corrective action.
Provide regular progress updates to management.

6. Quality Control & Safety

Conduct regular site inspections to verify installation quality and adherence to approved drawings.
Ensure compliance with applicable electrical safety standards and company procedures.
Monitor the use of PPE and safe working practices by all site personnel.
Identify installation defects, non-conformities, and rework requirements and ensure timely resolution.
Ensure proper testing, commissioning, and documentation before project handover.

7. Customer & Stakeholder Coordination

Coordinate with customers, vendors, contractors, internal teams, and other stakeholders at project sites.
Provide updates on project progress, execution timelines, and pending activities.
Resolve site-related customer concerns and technical issues promptly.
Coordinate required inspections, approvals, net-metering processes, and DISCOM-related activities, as applicable.
Ensure a smooth customer handover after successful project completion.

8. Reporting & Documentation

Submit daily site progress reports, including work completed, manpower deployed, materials used, and pending activities.
Maintain site visit records, project trackers, photographs, inspection reports, and execution documentation.
Report delays, risks, technical issues, and resource requirements to management immediately.
Maintain records of testing, commissioning, warranties, and final project handover.

Required Skills & Qualifications

B.Tech or Diploma in Electrical Engineering or a related technical field.
5–8 years of experience in solar project execution, preferably in solar EPC or rooftop solar installations.
Strong hands-on experience in managing site execution and installation teams.
Good understanding of solar PV systems, inverters, modules, mounting structures, electrical cabling, earthing, and commissioning.
Proven ability to plan site execution, manpower deployment, material requirements, and project schedules.
Experience managing contractors, vendors, technicians, and customer-site coordination.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make decisions independently at project sites.
Good communication, leadership, reporting, and coordination skills.
Willingness to travel extensively across assigned regions and stay at project locations when required.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Timely completion of solar projects against approved execution schedules.
Quality and accuracy of site execution and installation.
Effective site planning and manpower utilization.
Timely identification and resolution of site-level issues.
Availability of materials and resources before execution deadlines.
Compliance with safety standards and reduction in rework.
Accuracy and timeliness of daily site reports.
Customer satisfaction and successful project handover.

Come join the company building the security operating model for the age of AI. AI has changed how data is used — and security must change with it. Instead of perimeter controls and static policies, Cyera provides a unified control plane that understands relationships between data, access, and behaviors across humans, systems, and AI. Backed by the world’s leading investors and working with a large and growing list of Fortune 1000 companies, we are looking for world-class talent to join us as we usher in the new era of data and AI security.

About The Team

The Competitive Intelligence team is responsible for analyzing the competitive landscape across the market. The team focuses on understanding how competitor products work, evaluating technical claims, and identifying strengths, gaps, and risks. It works closely with Product Management, R&D, Sales, and Marketing to provide evidence-based insights that support product decisions, competitive positioning, and customer conversations.

The team’s output includes technical analyses, competitive reports, and materials used across the company to inform strategy and execution.

About The Role

We seek a highly skilled Technical Competitive Intelligence Analyst
to analyze and evaluate competitors' products. This role includes understanding our competitors' technical landscapes and providing insights that inform Cyera's product roadmap, enhance our competitive positioning, and drive innovation in data security solutions.

What You’ll Do

Analyze identity security products in depth, including their architectures, technology stacks, and key features across NHI, agentic identity, IGA, and adjacent PAM and ISPM.
Gather and synthesize competitive intelligence from field input, customer feedback, analyst reports, call intelligence, CRM data, and public sources to assess competitor claims and understand which vendors appear in deals, at what stage, and how we win.
Monitor competitor product updates, announcements, acquisitions, and new market entrants. Assess their potential impact and identify emerging technical risks and opportunities.
Partner with R&D, Product Management, Sales, and Marketing to identify differentiation opportunities, inform roadmap decisions, and share evidence-based win/loss insights.
Develop and maintain technical competitive assets, including deep-dive reports, battlecards, objection handlers, and technical comparisons, so teams can find and use current guidance.
Prioritize field requests by deal stage and provide fast support for POV and decision-stage deals.
Assist in creating and verifying technical benchmarks to assess Cyera’s products against competitors.

Requirements

3+ years of experience in technical analysis, cybersecurity, cloud technologies, or a related field, with a background in identity or security preferred.
Strong understanding of identity security, including NHI and agent access, or the ability to build expertise quickly.
Familiarity with cloud security, data protection, SaaS, and relevant markets such as DSPM, DLP, and AI security.
Ability to assess complex products and technical claims, then turn findings into concise, sourced, balanced guidance that sales teams can use.
Experience creating battlecards or other competitive materials.
Strong analytical judgment and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical findings and challenge assumptions with evidence.
Collaborative approach and ability to build trust with other teams.
Relevant experience may include competitive intelligence, sales engineering, industry analysis, identity product marketing, or IAM practice.

At Cyera, we care about collaboration, innovation, and agility. We take “teamwork” seriously—with our inclusive and supportive culture at the forefront—and we’re just as serious about nurturing Cyerans to grow, both personally and professionally.

This position provides analytical and organizational support to the business unit operations/management in KPIs reporting, compensation/incentives, forecasting and budget updates. The position performs all related duties in support of goals and objectives, as well as develops processes and proposals to increase the effectiveness of the operations. In addition, the position fosters continued program development and growth by conducting research and audits, as well as by producing statistical reports and analyses. The position coordinates project implementation across all facilities as needed

Responsibilities

Develop and administer new and existing programs impacting service delivery and quality, employee performance, internal and external performance management and service provider compensation/incentive payments.
Assist with development and preparation of annual budget, goals, and objectives. Provide monthly forecasting and effective budget updates. Implement individual portions of the strategic business plan. Assess, evaluate and recommend alterations to the business plan as needed.
Under close guidance, design, build, and maintain reporting that measures key operational KPIs. Develop internal reports on expenses, incentive programs, initiatives, and performance goals and results, including ad-hoc reports as needed.
Provide ad hoc data analysis in a variety of source systems and using a variety of data analysis tools/ languages (SQL, Tableau, Excel, Access). Identify and analyze trends with root cause analysis while providing solutions.
Assist with designing, building, and maintaining data tables in AWS and SQL for query optimization.
Collaborate with other Business Units such as Database and Analytics team to accomplish common goals and objectives.
Recognize, design, and integrate continuous improvement components to meet redesign needs.
Develop, implement, conduct, document and report results of program audit techniques required to ensure accuracy and adherence to policies, practices and operating procedures.
This position requires extensive knowledge in SQL, AWS or Snowflake databases with data mining knowledge as well as data visualization through Tableau. Work regularly requires the exercise of discretion and independent judgment in areas such as:
Querying large data sets, validating data,
Developing specialized reports/dashboards
Troubleshooting data issues
Developing solutions to complex data issues
Formulation of calculations to compute incentives, goals, forecasts

Qualifications

Bachelors equivalent combination of education and experience
Professional verbal and written communication skills required.
Strong SQL skills with data mining knowledge in AWS or Snowflake
Advanced Excel skills (incl. VBA, macros, complex calculations, etc.).
2-3 years prior analytical experience mandatory
Requires ability to compile, analyze and interpret statistical data.
Tableau preferred, Python a plus.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office software products, including Outlook, Word, Excel and Access required..
Professional organizational and time management skills required, as well as the ability to multitask and meet project deadlines as set by management.
Proven ability to produce recommendations and proposals and delegate and oversee projects and assignments to other employee
Southern California residency required

The starting pay range for this position is:

$80,100.00 - $107,000.00

Additionally, for full time positions, you will be eligible to participate in our incentive program based upon the achievement of organization, team and personal performance.

Remarkable benefits:

Health coverage for medical, dental, vision
401(K) saving plans with company match AND Pension
Tuition assistance
Floating holidays and PTO for community volunteer programs
Paid parental leave
Wellness programs
Employee discounts (membership, insurance,

travel, entertainment, services and more!)

Auto Club Enterprises is the largest club within the national AAA federation. We have nearly 17,000 employees in 24 states helping more than 18 million members. The strength of our organization is our employees. Bringing together and supporting different cultures, backgrounds, personalities, and strengths creates a team capable of delivering legendary, lifetime service to our members. When we embrace our diversity – we win. All of Us! With our national brand recognition, long-standing reputation since 1900, and constantly growing membership, we are seeking career-minded, service-driven professionals to join our team.

“Through dedicated employees we proudly deliver legendary service and beneficial products that provide members peace of mind and value.”

new_jobs.title: Data Analyst (E-commerce)
new_jobs.description:
Smo Tasty Dose ena najhitreje rastočih e-commerce zgodb v regiji. In to je šele začetek! 🚀

Razvijamo okusne funkcionalne napitke, ki izboljšujejo počutje in performance. Razviti v Sloveniji, uporabljeni vsak dan po celi Evropi.

Najbolj smo poznani po Coffee 2.0, ki smo jo ljudem postregli že v več kot 10.000.000 skodelicah.

Prisotni smo v 12+ EU državah, najdeš pa nas tudi na policah DM Slovenija in Tuš drogerij.
Iščemo nekoga, ki ne išče samo službe, ampak želi biti del hitro rastoče zgodbe, ki premika meje mogočega.

Če si tip človeka, ki stvari ne samo naredi, ampak jih naredi bolje kot večina, beri naprej.

Več o nas:
Tasty Dose

Tvoj naziv:
Data Analyst (E-commerce)

Kot Data Analyst boš povezoval podatke iz različnih virov ter jih pretvarjal v uporabne vpoglede, ki bodo pomagali pri rasti spletne prodaje, optimizaciji marketinga in sprejemanju strateških odločitev.

Tvoje glavne naloge:

-
zbiranje, povezovanje in upravljanje podatkov iz spletne trgovine, marketinških platform, CRM-ja, analitičnih orodij ter drugih virov,
- skrb za kakovost, točnost in konsistentnost podatkov ter sodelovanje pri razvoju podatkovne in BI infrastrukture,
- priprava analiz, dashboardov in rednih poročil za spremljanje poslovanja,
- analiza ključnih e-commerce metrik, kot so LTV, CAC, retention, konverzije in profitabilnost
,
- analiza uspešnosti marketinških kampanj, prodaje, produktov in posameznih trgov,izvajanje ad-hoc analiz za vodstvo in različne ekipe,
- prepoznavanje trendov, vzorcev in priložnosti za izboljšave,
- razvoj in izboljševanje BI sistemov, analitičnih procesov in avtomatizacij,
- pretvarjanje podatkov v konkretne poslovne predloge ter sodelovanje z vodstvom, marketingom, product in drugimi ekipami pri sprejemanju odločitev.

Tehnično okolje, v katerem boš delal:

Shopify, BigQuery + SQL, dbt, GA4, Cloud Run, Apps Script, Looker Studio, Google Sheets.

Kaj pričakujemo?

-
izkušnje na področju podatkovne analitike, BI ali podobnega področja,
- dobro razumevanje e-commerce in marketinških metrik,
- analitično razmišljanje in sposobnost kompleksne podatke pretvoriti v jasne poslovne vpoglede,
- razumevanje podatkovnih struktur in dela z različnimi viri podatkov,
- samostojnost, natančnost in sistematičnost,
- sposobnost učinkovitega sodelovanja z različnimi ekipami,
- zelo dobro znanje angleškega jezika.

Prednost predstavljajo izkušnje z e-commerce podjetji, BI sistemi, podatkovnimi bazami, API integracijami ali avtomatizacijo podatkovnih procesov.

Kaj ponujamo?

-
pomembno in vplivno vlogo v hitro rastočem e-commerce podjetju,
- delo s podatki, ki neposredno vplivajo na poslovne odločitve in rast,
- možnost razvoja podatkovne in BI infrastrukture,
- veliko prostora za samostojnost in prevzemanje odgovornosti,
- sodelovanje z ambiciozno in mednarodno ekipo,
- delo na več evropskih trgih,
- možnost osebnega in kariernega razvoja,
- konkurenčno plačilo glede na izkušnje in znanje.

Če te motivira delo s podatki in želiš svoje analitično znanje uporabiti v okolju, kjer imajo tvoji vpogledi neposreden vpliv na poslovanje, te vabimo k prijavi.

⬇️ Izpolni vprašalnik in se nam pridruži. ⬇️

new_jobs.description:
#herzderdigitalisierung sucht #mehrwertgeber:innen

Der Fokus der ITSV GmbH liegt in der Digitalisierung des österreichischen Gesundheitswesens. Wir steuern und koordinieren die IT-Aktivitäten der Sozialversicherung. Unsere Vision: Innovative Services und Leistungen, von denen täglich Millionen Menschen profitieren.

Als Cyber Security Analyst:in bist du Teil eines spezialisierten und hochmotivierten Expert:innenteams. Leidenschaftlich beschäftigst du dich mit Daten, Security Events, Protokollen, Logs und neuen Technologien und gestaltest die Informations- und Cybersicherheit in der Sozialversicherung aktiv mit. Fühlst du dich angesprochen? Dann freuen wir uns noch heute auf deine aussagekräftige Bewerbung!

Unser #mehrwert für dich

Gleitzeit ohne Kernzeit
Telearbeit als Teil unserer gelebten Work-Life-Balance
Familienfreundliche Unternehmenskultur
Fachliche und persönliche Aus- und Weiterbildungen
Dienstlaptop & -handy
Kollegiales Miteinander und Gestaltungsfreiraum
Jobticket & gute Anbindung, Parkplätze & Fahrradbox
Betriebsrestaurant & Essenzuschuss
Betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement
Mitarbeiter:innenevents & diverse Vergünstigungen

Deine Berufung

Incident Detection & Analysis: Analyse und Bewertung von Security Alerts und Incidents innerhalb des SOC sowie Priorisierung und Einleitung geeigneter Maßnahmen zur schnellen und effektiven Reaktion
Incident Response: Durchführung und Koordination von Incident-Response-Maßnahmen inklusive Containment, Eradication und Recovery sowie Dokumentation und Nachbereitung von Sicherheitsvorfällen
Use Case Feedback & Detection Improvement: Verbesserung bestehender Detection Rules und Entwicklung neuer Use Cases basierend auf Incident Learnings und Kundenanforderungen
SIEM & Tooling Nutzung: Aktive Arbeit mit SIEM- und Security-Tools (IBM QRadar) zur Analyse, Korrelation und Visualisierung sicherheitsrelevanter Ereignisse
Kundenkommunikation & Reporting: Kommunikation von Incidents, Risiken und Maßnahmen gegenüber internern Stakeholdern und Kund:innen sowie Erstellung von Reports und Empfehlungen
Qualität & Weiterentwicklung: Kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Analyseprozessen, Playbooks und SOC-Abläufen sowie Mentoring von Junior Analyst:innen
Threat Hunting: Proaktive Identifikation von Bedrohungen durch hypothesengetriebenes Threat Hunting auf Basis aktueller TTPs, Threat Intelligence und MITRE ATT&CK

Deine Qualifikation

Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung (HTL, FH, Uni) oder vergleichbare Qualifikation sowie mehrjährige Erfahrung im Bereich Security Operations, SOC oder Incident Response
Fundierte praktische Erfahrung in der Analyse und Bearbeitung von Security Incidents in einem SOC-Umfeld
Sehr gutes Verständnis von Angriffsvektoren, TTPs und gängigen Bedrohungsszenarien sowie Erfahrung mit Frameworks wie MITRE ATT&CK
Erfahrung mit SIEM- und Security-Tools (IBM QRadar, Microsoft Defender XDR) sowie sicherer Umgang mit Loganalyse aus Windows-, Linux- und Netzwerkquellen
Erfahrung im Threat Hunting sowie in der Entwicklung von Hypothesen zur Identifkation komplexer Angriffe
Grundlegende Kenntnisse in Scripting oder Automatisierung (z.B. Python, APIs) von Vorteil
Erfahrung in der strukturierten Dokumentation von Incidents sowie im Reporting gegenüber Kundschaft oder Management
Analytische, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten
Vorhandene Sicherheitsüberprüfung gemäß
55 SPG - Stufe "geheim" bzw. Bereitschaft zur Überprüfung

new_jobs.title: Operations Analyst
new_jobs.description:
About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

The ANZ Marketplace team owns the health of our ride-hailing marketplace across Australia and New Zealand — spanning trading efficiency, rider and driver experience, and risk & anti-fraud strategy. We work close to the business: diagnosing what's driving our core metrics, designing strategies from the ground up, and validating them in the real world. This role sits at the intersection of business and operations, with plenty of room to shape decisions that directly affect the experience of riders and drivers.

In this role, you'll be...

Develop a deep understanding of our ride-hailing marketplace — identify problems, get to the root cause behind movements in core business metrics (trading efficiency, rider/driver experience, etc.), and deliver optimisation recommendations backed by sound business judgement
Break down business situations in rider experience and operations (cancellation fees, cleaning fees, routing & toll disputes, driver misconduct, etc.), turning vague business phenomena into clear, actionable problems
Use data (data pulling, metric monitoring, and experiment validation where needed) to support business decisions, judge whether strategies are effective, and drive iteration
Capture analytical conclusions and business methodology into the team's ops tracker / knowledge base, improving how efficiently the team understands the business
Collaborate with Product, Operations, Risk and other cross-functional teams to drive project delivery across the Beijing and ANZ time zones

We're eager to be in touch because you have...

Bachelor's degree or above; discipline open, with a quantitative background (statistics, mathematics, actuarial studies, computer science, economics, engineering etc.) preferred
1–3 years of experience in operations / business analysis / strategy (outstanding new or recent graduates will also be considered)
Strong business understanding and logical judgement — able to independently break down ambiguous requirements into a clear analytical framework and reach conclusions with real commercial sense
Strong learner, highly proactive, able to make progress even when information is incomplete
Good written and verbal communication in both English and Chinese, comfortable collaborating across cross-functional teams

You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

new_jobs.title: Billing & Pricing Operations Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Ingram Micro is seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented professional to join our Billing & Pricing Operations team. This role is responsible for managing billing processes, pricing analysis, reconciliations, vendor coordination, and reporting. The position plays a key role in ensuring financial accuracy, driving operational efficiencies, and enabling data-driven decision-making across global operations.

Key Responsibilities

Operations Management:
Manage billing, pricing, and reconciliations with high accuracy and compliance.
Analyze vendor pricing, contracts, and financial data to resolve discrepancies.
Collaborate with vendors, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to ensure smooth operations.
Own high-priority and complex vendor/reseller issues and drive resolution.
Maintain data integrity across systems, regions, and stakeholders.
Support pricing decisions, validations, and approvals.
Reporting & Analytics:
Generate scheduled and ad-hoc reports across multiple regions.
Leverage advanced Excel, reporting tools, and automation for data analysis.
Build dashboards, templates, and reporting solutions.
Analysis of large datasets and provide data comprehension
Translate business requirements into actionable insights and reporting outputs.
Process Improvement:
Identify operational risks, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities.
Drive automation and continuous improvement initiatives.
Participate in cross-functional projects to improve productivity and service quality.
Escalation & Issue Management:
Investigate and resolve escalated issues through detailed analysis.
Collaborate with global teams to ensure timely resolution of business-impacting issues.
Subject Matter Expertise:
Maintain process documentation and ensure adherence to SOPs.
Provide guidance, training, and onboarding support to team members.
Act as a key point of contact for process-related queries.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Analytics, or related field.
3–5+ years of experience in billing, pricing, financial operations, or reporting.
Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, formulas, macros).
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience with reconciliations, financial data, and vendor operations.

Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills

SQL, Python, and data analysis capabilities.
Power BI or similar BI/visualization tools.
Experience with automation tools (Power Automate, VBA, RPA tools like UiPath).
Exposure to AI/ML or intelligent automation in reporting/operations.
Experience in Cloud Products and Vendors – Billing and Pricing
Experience with CRM, ERP, or financial systems.

Key Competencies

Data-driven decision-making
Strong attention to detail and accuracy
Collaboration and stakeholder engagement
Continuous improvement and automation minds

new_jobs.title: Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
We’re looking for a curious and detail-oriented Data Analyst who enjoys working with data and turning it into meaningful insights. In this role, you’ll help us understand what the numbers are telling us, identify trends, and provide information that helps the team make better decisions.

You’ll work closely with different teams to understand their needs, solve business problems, and present findings in a clear and practical way. We’re looking for someone who is comfortable asking questions, enjoys solving problems, and can explain data in a way that makes sense to both technical and non-technical colleagues.

Key Responsibilities

Collect, clean, organize, and analyze data from different sources to ensure accuracy and reliability.
Work with business teams to understand their goals, challenges, and reporting needs.
Create and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Excel.
Use SQL to retrieve, manipulate, and analyze data from databases.
Identify patterns, trends, and potential issues that can help improve business performance.
Translate complex data into clear insights and practical recommendations.
Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and prepare regular reports for stakeholders.
Investigate data discrepancies and work with relevant teams to resolve them.
Support business planning and decision-making through data-driven analysis.
Look for opportunities to improve reporting processes, data quality, and analytical workflows.

Skills And Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Good working knowledge of SQL and data analysis techniques.
Experience with Excel and at least one data visualization tool, such as Power BI or Tableau.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an eye for detail.
Ability to interpret data, recognize trends, and explain findings clearly.
Good communication skills and the ability to work with people across different teams.
A willingness to learn new tools, ask questions, and explore better ways of working.
Ability to manage multiple tasks, meet deadlines, and maintain accuracy in day-to-day work.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means more than preparing reports. It means helping the team understand what is happening in the business and why. You’ll be successful when your analysis answers important questions, your reports are reliable and easy to understand, and your insights help people make informed decisions.

What We’re Looking For

We value someone who is thoughtful, dependable, and genuinely interested in understanding data. You don’t need to have every answer right away, but you should be comfortable exploring problems, learning from feedback, and working with others to find the right answers.

If you enjoy connecting the dots, finding meaning in numbers, and helping people make better decisions, we’d love to hear from you.

new_jobs.description:
We’re looking for a curious and detail-oriented Data Analyst who enjoys working with data and turning it into meaningful insights. In this role, you’ll help us understand what the numbers are telling us, identify trends, and provide information that helps the team make better decisions.

You’ll work closely with different teams to understand their needs, solve business problems, and present findings in a clear and practical way. We’re looking for someone who is comfortable asking questions, enjoys solving problems, and can explain data in a way that makes sense to both technical and non-technical colleagues.

Key Responsibilities

Collect, clean, organize, and analyze data from different sources to ensure accuracy and reliability.
Work with business teams to understand their goals, challenges, and reporting needs.
Create and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Excel.
Use SQL to retrieve, manipulate, and analyze data from databases.
Identify patterns, trends, and potential issues that can help improve business performance.
Translate complex data into clear insights and practical recommendations.
Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and prepare regular reports for stakeholders.
Investigate data discrepancies and work with relevant teams to resolve them.
Support business planning and decision-making through data-driven analysis.
Look for opportunities to improve reporting processes, data quality, and analytical workflows.

Skills And Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Good working knowledge of SQL and data analysis techniques.
Experience with Excel and at least one data visualization tool, such as Power BI or Tableau.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with an eye for detail.
Ability to interpret data, recognize trends, and explain findings clearly.
Good communication skills and the ability to work with people across different teams.
A willingness to learn new tools, ask questions, and explore better ways of working.
Ability to manage multiple tasks, meet deadlines, and maintain accuracy in day-to-day work.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means more than preparing reports. It means helping the team understand what is happening in the business and why. You’ll be successful when your analysis answers important questions, your reports are reliable and easy to understand, and your insights help people make informed decisions.

What We’re Looking For

We value someone who is thoughtful, dependable, and genuinely interested in understanding data. You don’t need to have every answer right away, but you should be comfortable exploring problems, learning from feedback, and working with others to find the right answers.

If you enjoy connecting the dots, finding meaning in numbers, and helping people make better decisions, we’d love to hear from you.

About Phi Partners

Phi Partners has been a trusted capital markets consultancy for more than 20 years, providing quantitative and technology expertise across front office, pricing and risk. We support more than 80 financial institutions across the buy-side and sell-side through niche capabilities spanning quant, engineering, vendor platforms and cloud infrastructure.
Our teams work on complex, real-world problems across models, analytics, applications, data and cloud infrastructure, within an international delivery organisation built around regional hubs and specialist centres of excellence. For people who enjoy technically demanding work in capital markets, Phi offers the opportunity to work closely with expert colleagues and major financial institutions on high-value, business-critical initiatives.

About the Programme

We are supporting one of the world’s largest institutional investors, a global sovereign wealth fund investing across public and private markets. The opportunity sits within the client’s Public Markets Data team, which supports the investment business across risk data, including counterparty credit risk, market risk, margining and collateral, as well as market data and trade execution. The client is consolidating its data capabilities onto Databricks as an enterprise-level data platform, making this a key area of its broader technology and data strategy.
Phi Partners is looking for a Techno-Functional Business Analyst to act as the bridge between the investment business and the data engineering teams. This is not a traditional, analysis-only BA role: the successful candidate will also be expected to work hands-on with the data and the pipelines behind it. The role will initially focus on one of the team’s key areas, with the opportunity to develop broader knowledge across the Public Markets Data function over time. The client understands that candidates may not have deep knowledge of every area from day one and will support the successful candidate in building it.
As an example of the work, a front-office or compliance team might ask for a new metric on an existing dashboard, such as a 36-month rolling beta. The Business Analyst would trace where the underlying time-series data comes from and what it represents, work out how the metric should be derived, and specify it so a data engineer can build it directly.

Roles and Responsibilities

The successful candidate will work at the intersection of investment data, business analysis and technology, helping stakeholders turn complex data requirements into practical solutions. The role requires someone who can investigate problems independently, understand the underlying financial and technical context, and work effectively across business and engineering teams.
Key Responsibilities:
Gather and translate requirements from Front Office and business stakeholders into clear technical and data specifications
Analyse datasets, data flows and dependencies, defining source-to-target mappings, transformations, data models and data quality requirements
Work hands-on with Databricks, Spark and SQL to profile data, develop or review pipelines, investigate issues and validate outputs
Create lightweight prototypes where required to help stakeholders visualise and refine reporting or data solutions
Manage a personal Book of Work across multiple smaller workstreams, independently investigating requirements and proposing solutions
Work closely with Data Engineers and business stakeholders throughout delivery, ensuring effective communication between business and technology teams

Key Skills

Mandatory skills include:
Minimum five years as a Business Analyst or BA/PM, with substantial data engineering experience and delivery on projects in the financial domain
Hands-on Python and PySpark coding experience, ideally on Databricks, is essential
Advanced SQL (complex joins, window functions, reconciliations) for in-depth data analysis
Good understanding of financial markets and investment concepts across buy side and sell side, ideally with exposure to security master, reference data, market data, the trade lifecycle or other investment-related data
High-level understanding of risk modelling and instrument pricing: how an instrument is priced and how risk is measured, without needing quant-level depth
Experience working with structured financial data and data modelling concepts
Comfortable working directly with front-office users and using their terminology
Ability to manage several workstreams in parallel with limited supervision
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, able to explain technical design to investment professionals and investment concepts to engineers
Bachelor’s degree in IT, Finance, Engineering or a related field

Nice to Have Skills:
Domain exposure to trade execution, counterparty credit risk, market risk, or margining and collateral
Experience with the Azure data stack and Azure DevOps
Experience with Power BI or an equivalent BI tool
Databricks certification or an investment qualification such as CFA (any level) or IMC
Previous experience at a sovereign wealth fund, large asset manager or investment bank

Next steps

This is an opportunity to join a growing capital markets consultancy and work within the data team of one of the world’s largest institutional investors. The role offers close exposure to front-office stakeholders and the chance to build broad knowledge across investment data while staying hands-on technically. If you are interested, please send a copy of your up-to-date CV to ashutosh.pawar@phipartners.com. We look forward to discussing the role with you in more detail.

new_jobs.title: Senior / Staff Technical Program Manager, AI Research
new_jobs.description:
At Rhoda AI, we’re building the next generation of generalist intelligent robots. We own the full robotics stack from high-performance hardware and robot systems to the infrastructure and state-of-the-art foundation world models that control our robots. Our robots are designed to be generalists capable of operating in complex, real-world environments and handling long-tail edge cases, made possible by our cutting edge research and end-to-end system design. We've raised over $450M and are investing aggressively in model research, infrastructure, hardware development, and manufacturing scale-up to make generalist robotics a reality.

The role

We're looking for a Senior/Staff Technical Program Manager, AI Research
to help scale how research programs come together at Rhoda. This is a deeply technical, cross-functional execution role at the intersection of pre-training, post-training, applied research, data, GPU infrastructure, robotic hardware, and customer-facing model delivery.

You'll own the integrated execution plan
across these efforts: connecting milestones, anticipating dependencies, driving blockers to resolution, and helping teams make timely resource and sequencing decisions. The objective is to give researchers and engineers more time to build, while making the path from research experiments to usable models more predictable.

You'll work closely with Research leadership, technical leads, infrastructure, robotics, and hardware teams. You won't need to invent the scientific roadmap yourself—but you should be technical enough to understand it, challenge assumptions constructively, and turn ambiguity into practical options.

What You'll Do

Build the integrated research roadmap. Translate individual project plans into a clear, continuously updated view of experiments, model and data readiness, system integrations, releases, dependencies, critical paths, and decision points.
Connect model development to downstream use. Coordinate the transitions from pre-training checkpoints to post-training, applied model engineering, evaluation, and deployment; align on handoff criteria, owners, and readiness expectations.
Synchronize data, compute, and hardware. Anticipate when training datasets, collection systems, robots, workcells, and GPU capacity need to be available; manage resource demand forecasts and routine scheduling trade-offs within agreed priorities.
Drive blockers to resolution. Identify cross-team gaps before they become delays, bring the right owners together, maintain action plans and contingencies, and escalate consequential trade-offs with a concrete recommendation.
Surface capacity and staffing risks early. Help research leaders understand where milestones need additional engineering capacity, specialized expertise, or reprioritization; support decisions without owning personnel management.
Build lightweight execution rhythms. Run focused program reviews, maintain decision and dependency logs, and create concise, reliable updates for technical leadership without burying researchers in process.
Manage uncertainty intelligently. Distinguish experiments, proof-of-concept demonstrations, engineering-readiness milestones, and customer-deployment commitments; track confidence and learning goals instead of forcing speculative research into false precision.
Improve cross-functional execution. Partner with hardware and operations TPMs and program leads to clarify interfaces, ownership, acceptance criteria, and release expectations as Rhoda scales.

What we're looking for

Significant technical program management experience delivering complex, interdependent work across software, ML, research infrastructure, robotics, or similarly technical organizations; senior or staff-level judgment.
Strong understanding of the machine learning development lifecycle, including datasets, model training, evaluation, iteration, and the practical challenges of moving models into production.
Demonstrated ability to build an execution system from an ambiguous starting point, identify true critical dependencies, and drive progress across teams without direct reporting authority.
Technical fluency sufficient to work credibly with researchers and infrastructure engineers, ask the right questions, and present real trade-offs—not just collect status.
Experience coordinating constrained engineering resources, such as compute capacity, test systems, labs, hardware platforms, or specialized teams.
Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to turn many threads of technical work into a concise, decision-ready view for leadership.
Sound judgment about when to solve a coordination issue independently, when to involve technical owners, and when a decision needs leadership attention.

Nice to have

Experience in large-scale model training, foundation models, generative models, computer vision, embodied AI, or robotics.
Familiarity with GPU clusters, data pipelines, robot testing and evaluation, or hardware/software integration.
Experience bridging research organizations and customer-facing applied engineering or model release functions.

Why this matters

Rhoda's capability roadmap spans faster task adaptation, instruction and demonstration following, higher execution speed, and dexterous manipulation. These breakthroughs depend on models, data, hardware, compute, and evaluation becoming ready in the right sequence.
